verdict.rationale: Apple M5 is a system-on-chip, a hardware component that does not collect user data or run a service with a training-data policy, so an opt-out from AI training is a category error for this product type. The evidence about running models 'completely on device' describes local inference capability, not a data-use control, and does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
